problem:
Let $x,y,z>0$ such that
$$(x+y+z)\left(\frac1x+\frac1y+\frac1z\right)=\frac{91}{10}$$
Compute
$$\left[(x^3+y^3+z^3)\left(\frac1{x^3}+\frac1{y^3}+\frac1{z^3}\right)\right]$$
where $[.]$ represents the integer part.

[i]Proposed by Marian Cucoanoeş and Marius Drăgan[/i]

# Finding the Integer Part of $(x^3+y^3+z^3)(1/x^3+1/y^3+1/z^3)$

## Setting Up the Problem

Let me define the pairwise ratio sums:
$$a = \frac{x}{y}+\frac{y}{x}, \quad b = \frac{y}{z}+\frac{z}{y}, \quad c = \frac{z}{x}+\frac{x}{z}$$

**Expanding the given constraint:**
$$(x+y+z)\left(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y}+\frac{1}{z}\right) = 3 + \left(\frac{x}{y}+\frac{y}{x}\right) + \left(\frac{y}{z}+\frac{z}{y}\right) + \left(\frac{z}{x}+\frac{x}{z}\right) = \frac{91}{10}$$

This gives:
$$a + b + c = 9.1 - 3 = 6.1$$

## Expressing the Target Quantity

Expanding the target expression:
$$S_3T_3 = 3 + \left[\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)^3+\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)^3\right] + \left[\left(\frac{y}{z}\right)^3+\left(\frac{z}{y}\right)^3\right] + \left[\left(\frac{z}{x}\right)^3+\left(\frac{x}{z}\right)^3\right]$$

Using the identity $t^3 + \frac{1}{t^3} = \left(t+\frac{1}{t}\right)^3 - 3\left(t+\frac{1}{t}\right)$:
$$S_3T_3 = 3 + (a^3-3a) + (b^3-3b) + (c^3-3c) = a^3+b^3+c^3 - 3(a+b+c) + 3$$

$$\boxed{S_3T_3 = a^3+b^3+c^3 - 18.3 + 3 = a^3+b^3+c^3 - 15.3}$$

## Bounding $a^3 + b^3 + c^3$

Since each ratio $\frac{x}{y} > 0$, by AM-GM: $a, b, c \geq 2$, with $a+b+c = 6.1$.

**Minimum** (when $a=b=c=6.1/3$ by convexity of $t^3$):
$$a^3+b^3+c^3 \geq 3\left(\frac{6.1}{3}\right)^3 = \frac{6.1^3}{9} = \frac{226.981}{9} \approx 25.220$$

**Maximum** (when two variables hit the boundary $a=b=2$, giving $c=2.1$):
$$a^3+b^3+c^3 \leq 8+8+(2.1)^3 = 16 + 9.261 = 25.261$$

## Computing the Final Range

$$S_3T_3 \in \left[25.220 - 15.3,\; 25.261 - 15.3\right] = \left[9.920,\; 9.961\right]$$

Since the entire range lies strictly within $(9, 10)$, the integer part is uniquely determined:

$$\lfloor S_3T_3 \rfloor = 9$$

## Verification

- $S_3T_3 < 10$ requires $a^3+b^3+c^3 < 25.3$: ✓ (max is 25.261)  
- $S_3T_3 \geq 9$ requires $a^3+b^3+c^3 \geq 24.3$: ✓ (min is 25.220)

$$\boxed{9}$$
